name: routeweather-pro-app
description: RouteWeather Pro — Android and iPhone app (Capacitor wrapper around the web app)

scripts.sync: npm run prepare-web && npx cap sync
scripts.add-android: npx cap add android && node scripts/configure-native.js android && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android
scripts.add-ios: npx cap add ios && node scripts/configure-native.js ios && npx @capacitor/assets generate --ios
